scope: One manually invoked finite-run coordinator; no timer loop, provider client, model launch or external system activation
criteria: Initialize only fresh synthetic principal/exchange/run databases with a fixed finite wake budget and absolute deadline; reject invalid/nonfinite parameters; no reset, extension or migration command.
Reserve each wake durably before calling the existing tick; concurrent processes and restarts cannot exceed the fixed budget; uncertain reserved attempts are never refunded or repeated.

Persist observed time and enforce deadline at admission and again before tick; a detected backward clock stops the run; deadline governs admission rather than cancellation of an already admitted wake.

WAIT before its deadline, BLOCK and verified COMPLETE cause no tick/planner/worker invocation; no ready request means one prepare tick is allowed; an existing request awaiting dispatch does not waste wake budget.

Any recorded provider launch without a matching bound response stops admission, including stale requests; never dispatch or relaunch a provider job; delivery validation remains in the unchanged exchange.
Unresolved response consumption, principal lease/recovery ambiguity and unacknowledged coordinator attempts stop admission for review; never infer success from a reservation or an unrelated receipt.

Bind run configuration and every reservation/result to run identity, initial objective, current principal version/state/journal evidence and exchange evidence; unexpected principal changes or damaged/mismatched records fail closed.

Persist terminal stops across restart; do not automatically create another run or new objective. A bound response arriving for the exact waiting request may permit a later manually invoked step within the same remaining budget/deadline.

Keep existing 26 regression tests passing and pulse modules, planner protocol, exchange implementation and old evidence unchanged; label simulated provider/time/fault tests explicitly and do not claim unattended scheduling.

Independent final adversarial review, exact source hashes, sanitized handoff and verified isolated GitHub feature commit are required. Existing Atlas R3/Gage R2 acceptance and six-scheduled-wake requirement remain unchanged and unproven.
